title: Cost Control Confirmation Prompt for AI Queries
body:
**Bug Description**
I just spent $0.20 on a query and I didn't mean to. I wish there was a way to specify per-prompt thresholds above which the system would ask for confirmation of whether inference is actually run.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.8
- Feedback ID: d33a6a51-8333-4914-8e42-b78bf3d8bf4b
author: varungodbole
